diagnosis: The bot is roughly break-even at the macro level (50.7% WR, -$68.37 over 404 trades) but this masks a severely bimodal strategy mix: ARB setups are excellent (92% WR, +$5.89 over 13 trades) while MOMENTUM is the dominant volume driver and a clear loser (49% WR, -$55.81 over 383 trades). Within momentum, the lesson-bucket data pinpoints the leak precisely: trades with 10-20bps moves lose heavily (-$33.47 over 81 trades, 34.6% WR) and are now correctly vetoed, trades with left60-120s remaining lose heavily (-$20.25 over 59 trades, 35.6% WR) and are vetoed, and price<0.45 entries lose badly (-$19.54, 30.6% WR) and are vetoed. These vetoes are working as intended — recent decision logs show consistent, correct SKIPs on move10-20 setups. However the bot continues entering in bucket 'left60-120' implicitly via min_entry_left_sec=130 which is borderline-inconsistent with the veto threshold of 120s, and continues trading 'all-agree' setups (-$18.99 over 112 trades) and 'alone' setups (-$4.26 over 36, flagged reduce_confidence but action not yet enforced in logs). DOGE (-$23.45, 39% WR) and ETH (-$25.40, 54% WR but worst single trade -$15.93) are the biggest coin-level bleeders versus BTC which is solidly profitable (+$10.83, 60% WR). The current live state shows the bot correctly skipping most 10-20bps moves but still taking entries at ask 0.55-0.65 in the stop-loss/high-move>20bps zone that the data says is profitable (+$10.14 over 43 trades, 55.8% WR) — this is good. Overall the bot has a working veto layer but mis-sized risk per trade (stop_loss_bid 0.22 causing large -$15 to -$19 single losses) and is not yet exploiting its most profitable detected edges (move20+, left120+, ARB) with larger size.
priorityActions: Raise min_entry_left_sec from 130 to 121+ to cleanly exit the validated-loser left60-120s zone while preserving entry into the profitable left120+ zone.
Tighten stop_loss_bid from 0.22 to ~0.30 to cap tail-loss severity, given worst trades are -$15 to -$19 against a bankroll of only $33.55.

Enforce the 'reduce_confidence' action on all-agree (112 trades, -$18.99) with a concrete confidence penalty or size reduction, not just experimental status — this is the single largest-sample negative-expectancy bucket still fully active.

Reallocate capital/attention toward ARB and move20+ setups (both solidly profitable) by modestly raising max_trade_pct and max_open_positions, since bankroll is small and the few good setups are currently capital-constrained.

Investigate DOGE-updown specifically (39% WR, -$23.45) — consider a coin-specific confidence penalty or temporary reduced exposure until a root cause (liquidity, volatility profile) is identified, since it is disproportionately worse than other coins despite similar setup logic.
